checkpoint: Previously verified released Diffusion Policy CNN, unchanged EMA weights and native image/robot observations

gate.healthy_requirement: At least 8/10 sham completions under the same intervention timing; prior nominal ability retained as separate evidence.

event: First payload dual grasp sustained for three successive policy steps. Event selection is evaluator-only and does not enter the frozen policy. Receiver (arm 1) is then opened for 12 steps with fixed prior pose goals and donor gripper closed. No pose/state edits.
fault_valid: At injection end donor grasp holds and receiver grasp is lost. Validity failures retain their denominators.
holding: Registered or entry-measured positions for 1/20 steps, same wrists, donor closed; receiver open only under fault.
resume: Discard the remaining already queried action chunk; refresh the last two RGB/robot observations after fault and holding; query the unchanged policy.
native_horizon: Exactly 700 active policy action steps, plus separately charged 12-step fault/sham and 1/20-step waiting. No scripted recovery fallback.
formal_matrix: 20 seeds x fault/sham x two position references x two waits
timing: Native synchronous benchmark: record active control, injection and waiting simulation time, actual batch query time, and the legacy observable-fetch timer. That timer does not isolate camera acquisition; no complete deployment-latency claim or direct comparison with lifting full-service cost.
stopping: If the engineering ability gate fails, stop this route, do not train weights, alter fault severity or run formal cells. If passed, freeze and run all 160 cells regardless outcomes. Total new formal <=400.
outcome: R = native bin completion AND triggered support event AND valid fault/sham prefix; C_native is always retained separately. All assigned formal seeds remain in denominators.
